verdict.rationale: Metorial explicitly supports plugging in MCP servers (remote or custom-hosted) and merging their tools into a session for AI agents to use, with docs, SDKs, and a live API/portal confirming this works end-to-end. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the exact MCP-plugging workflow (only vendor docs and a runtime probe of adjacent endpoints, not a third-party test of connecting a custom MCP server end-to-end).
